description: A US street address (one line, or street with city/state or ZIP) or a latitude/longitude, resolved by the Census Bureau geocoder: coordinates, standardized address, and every geography it lies in: state and county FIPS, tract, block group and block GEOIDs, place, ZIP tabulation area, congressional district (e.g. NY-12), state senate and house districts, school district, metro area, CSA, urban area and PUMA. Public-domain data. Costs $0.002 USDC on Base via x402.

address.description: One-line US address (350 5th Ave, New York, NY 10118)

lat.description: Or latitude, for a reverse lookup (with lon)

street.description: Or the street line, with city and state, or zip

name: us_address_geocode
